title: An incentive paid upfront
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cash path versus the final cash balance.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the cash path versus the final cash balance affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cash path versus the final cash balance in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
